title: Sweet and Spicy Brazilian Stuffed Yams
description: A delicious and flavorful dish that combines the sweetness of yams with the spiciness of Brazilian peppers. Perfect for a dinner or side dish.

ingredients.name: yams
ingredients.notes: Choose firm, unblemished yams for best results

ingredients.name: yellow sweet peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color sweet pepper can be used, but yellow adds a nice pop of color

ingredients.name: Brazilian peppers
ingredients.notes: Also known as malagueta peppers, these add a spicy kick

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: A 10-inch cast-iron skillet works well for this recipe

instructions: Poke the yams with a fork several times to allow steam to escape.
Bake the yams for 45-60 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
While the yams are baking, heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Brazilian peppers to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the sliced yellow sweet peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
When the yams are done, let them cool for a few minutes before slicing them in half lengthwise.
Scoop out some of the yam flesh to make room for the pepper filling.
Fill each yam with the pepper mixture and serve immediately.
Optional: top with cheese, sour cream, or chives for extra flavor
